description: Ski-equipped C-130D later converted to GC-130D ground trainer; flew with Alaskan Air Command then the 109th Airlift Wing 1975-1985 on Greenland and DEW Line support; placed on static display as gate guard in 1994; known on base as Old 490; repainted in original grey-and-orange by wing volunteers and reported restored in a DVIDS article dated 15 July 2026
